record.title: Iraq Syria Qaim closure after Assad fall
record.exceptions: Humanitarian movements and stranded trucks; exceptional repatriations, including Syrian soldiers on 19 December, documented before June 2025.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no current-status inference
record.official_rationale: Secure frontier following collapse of Syrian government.
record.context: The 8 December 2024 full-closure announcement followed selective admission restrictions from 1 December. Humanitarian movement and stranded trucks were subsequently admitted before regular trade and passenger reopening in June 2025.
record.uncertainty: 14 June 2025 is regular operational reopening, not the first permitted movement. Earlier partial restrictions and later humanitarian/stranded-truck exceptions rule out a continuous 188-day all-traffic closure.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty
